data.narrative:
Zephyr Fusion is a pre-seed nuclear energy company founded by Dr. Galen Burke and Dr. Edward Hinson, both with 15+ and 20+ years respectively in plasma physics and diagnostics from national laboratories. The company has raised $500K to date. The nuclear energy sector comp universe includes 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 6 private peers including Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and Fuse Energy.

Valuation analysis relies on the Stage-Progression method, as the Peer-Median approach is not applicable. The nuclear energy sector contains only one adjacent-stage comparable and insufficient clustering within valuation tiers to support median-based triangulation. The Stage-Progression method applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier from the $500K raised proxy, yielding an implied value of $1.25M at the pre-seed-to-seed progression. This approach reflects typical venture capital deployment patterns in capital-intensive hardware sectors.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.06M to $1.44M, with a median of $1.25M. This range is narrow—reflecting reliance on a single applicable method rather than triangulation across multiple approaches. Key uncertainties include the absence of comparable pre-seed transactions in nuclear fusion or advanced fission, limiting empirical validation of the step-up multiplier. The founder team's national laboratory pedigree and domain expertise provide qualitative support for post-seed capital deployment, though near-term technical milestones and capital requirements remain undisclosed.
